measures.title: Transportation Benefit District of Chehalis: Sales and Use Tax Levy Renewal for Transportation Needs
measures.summary: The Transportation Benefit District of Chehalis, governed by the Chehalis City Council, asks voters under Resolution No. 17-2026 to renew its sales and use tax of two-tenths of one percent (0.2%) for ten more years, from July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2037. Revenue would fund projects in the City's Transportation Improvement Plan, traffic engineering and control, and operation, maintenance and repair of city streets, bridges and other transportation infrastructure. If not approved, the current tax expires June 30, 2027.
measures.yesMeans: The 0.2% Chehalis Transportation Benefit District sales and use tax would continue through June 30, 2037.
measures.noMeans: The 0.2% Chehalis Transportation Benefit District sales and use tax would expire on June 30, 2027.
